evals.prompt: A manual Flutter Windows publisher is ready for an exact commit. `gh workflow run publish-windows.yml --ref <40-character-SHA>` fails before creating a run, even though actions/checkout can check out that SHA. What is the canonical dispatch and admission contract?

Rejects falling back to the moving branch tip after admission or treating a failed dispatch request as a hosted Windows attempt
Adds a contract fixture that rejects raw-SHA --ref usage and mismatched event/input SHAs while accepting branch-or-tag dispatch plus exact-SHA input
Keeps the compact workflow topology and one-build contract unchanged

Audits sibling helper and installer launches for the same flattening mechanism before another native or paid attempt

evals.prompt: A first-release Windows installer lifecycle test launches the production Flutter EXE in a hidden storage-probe mode. evals.prompt: A release gateway route contains a version with `+`. The publisher encodes it as `%2B`, but the gateway regex matches only literal `+`, so the request returns 404 before authentication. Adds red fixtures for encoded 404, double encoding, object-existence leakage, redirect following, and discarded status diagnostics
